title: Concept: Ceph RADOS gateway bucket listing in a response
description: An object listing served by a Ceph RADOS gateway in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The gateway is the bank's own storage tier, so a listing exposes internal bucket names, tenant layout and object naming that the App assumes are private.
applicability: Deployments that render an object listing served by a Ceph RADOS gateway into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The gateway is the bank's own storage tier, so a listing exposes internal bucket names, tenant layout and object naming that the App assumes are private.
